messages:
oncall-bot: [P1] prod-east exec-proxy queue growth > 10k, external execs 5xx rate 12% — automatic soft-rate limiting applied to external execs. Pager pinned to @leo
leo: picking up. digging into proxy queue and batch worker metrics now.
anya: seeing correlated spike with cached-kv eviction on mos-gpu-02, GC churn may be stalling workers.
leo: confirmed — queue depth jump at 12:34 UTC, worker timeouts + OOM churn on a few pods.
sara: initiating mitigation: plan to restrict external execs (free-tier first) + lower per-tenant parallelism to 1. flipping feature flag in staged rollout.
mike: noted. I'll prep a short customer comm and alert support. @sara roughly how long to stage?
sara: doing a staged flip via flags API now, will push to 10% then monitor for 5m.
sara: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/flags
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN"
  -d '{"path":"exec_proxy.external_enabled","value":false,"scope":"free-tier","staged":true}'
```
infra-bot: deploybot: flag change staged at 1748765480 by sara.
leo: after staged change, routing team will apply text-only fallback for affected routes and ramp down batch workers. updating routing rule now.
leo: ```json
{"route":"prod-east","policy":"text_only_fallback","priority":800}
```
anya: monitoring: staged tenants show tool-exec errors down ~60%, overall p95 latency for text-only fallback +80ms but throughput stabilized.
mike: publishing status page draft: "Temporary restriction on external tool executions in prod-east while we stabilize" — sending to #support for gating.
ops: support channel notified, triage doc created: https://confluence.internal/prod-east-tool-exec-incident
leo: staying on incident lead. if stable at +30m we consider widening restriction to paid tiers or gradually re-enabling with stricter quotas. handing to @sara for runbook collection and PM follow-up.
sara: ack — creating postmortem stub, collecting kube logs and kv eviction traces. will capture flag timeline.
oncall-bot: Incident P1 assigned -> eng-sre, runbook updated, next check-in scheduled in 15m. :rotating_light:
